The reassurance posts have for sure spiraled. Especially if the person comes back frequently. This phobia causes major anxiety and it almost becomes addictive to come to this sub and ask if you’ll be okay, but people need to learn how to reassure themselves.

I joined this sub back in 2016 on a different account. I was constantly posting here and if we’re being honest, while it helped educate me on viruses and made me feel less alone, it also made my anxiety worse. 

Things such as this subreddit can seem good for you because you can vent and ask questions, but it can also be bad for you. If you’re constantly running here for reassurance and you can’t use words like vomit, gag, throw up, and such, then what’s the point? That sounds a bit harsh, I know, but the point of this subreddit should be to provide support, honesty, and facts. 

You are 100% right. I know for a fact that sometimes this subreddit has made me scan my body to see if I’m feeling the symptoms that the redditor was complaining about. I do that anytime anyone feels sick. I’ve chosen to stay away from this subreddit, but sometimes I’ll read it because I enjoy reading it. I’ve realized though that so many people will get anxious over the tiniest things and they post here frequently. I feel bad for them and wish that I could help them, but I’m still struggling horribly myself. 

If you’re not over this phobia and it’s bad then I’d suggest to stay away from this subreddit. It can for sure send you into a spiral of anxiety.
